admission.justification: At width 390 the host offers no live front-agent value, so the old pill was a control that could not act — the developer's own report. Gating the pill on the same value the bridge checks removes every dead button while keeping the wide-layout navigation; the worker's witnesses at both widths stand behind it.

applicability: The 'Back to parent' composer pill the plugin draws in the host's message box.
conditions: The pill is offered only while the plugin knows which agent is in front by the same live value the unchanged bridge check uses.
When the value becomes known at the wide layout the pill comes back; when it is unknown at any width the pill is removed.
exclusions: The title, a value remembered from an earlier moment and opening the picker are never sources for the agent in front.
At the narrow layout the host's own list is the navigation; no command, second route or dashboard element is added for it.
The bridge's check and the messages between plugin and dashboard are unchanged.
statement: Parent is offered only for the same live known-source value used by the unchanged bridge; unknown source removes it at every width and known wide selection restores it.
